g.title: HR_TIMETRACKERPROJ_ACTIVITY
g.text: Time Tracker Project Activities - This entity links the Time Tracker Projects and Activities
Id of the Time Tracker Project linked to this job.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_TIMETRACKERPROJECT
g.text: Time Tracker Project - Time Tracker Project
Flag to indicate if the project is billable.
Indicates the name of the customer
Amount of a Time Tracker Project
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
